purpose: Frozen full HTML inputs for benchmarking exhaustive current MP-to-riding extraction from the 45th Canadian Parliament. Not model-generated answers.
expected_answers_status: Two independent source-local references prepared. Each has 337 distinct current-as-presented MP-riding pairs. Wikipedia historical exclusions, literal labels and the member disagreement are preserved; neither reference imports corrections from the other page.
